headline: Katotobwe pushes for harmonised Zambia-Malawi trade standards
summary: Zambia's Minister of Trade and Exports, Caroline Katotobwe, said harmonising product standards with Malawi would reduce technical trade barriers. The comments came at the signing of an MoU between the two countries' standards bodies.
why: Product standards and technical barriers determine how easily goods cross borders. Harmonisation can lower costs for exporters and improve regional market access.
